properties.name: Yam Suph / Red Sea crossing area (debated)
properties.location: Representative NE Delta lakes / Isthmus candidate (debated vs Gulf of Suez / Aqaba)
properties.what_happened: Israel passes through the sea on dry ground; Pharaoh’s army is overthrown. The Song of the Sea follows. Exact water body (Ballah Lakes / Bitter Lakes / Suez / Aqaba) remains vigorously debated.
properties.sources: Exodus 14–15; Numbers 33 (LSB). OpenBible.info Bible Geocoding Data (Red Sea 1). Hoffmeier Ancient Israel in Sinai; ABR sea-crossing essays; AiG Searching for Sinai (lists crossing options). Contested layer notes Ron Wyatt claims separately.
properties.notes: MAJOR DEBATE: Hoffmeier/ABR often favor Ballah Lakes / NE Delta reed-sea; traditional maps often Gulf of Suez; popular Aqaba/Nuweiba theories exist. Pin uses OpenBible Red Sea 1 best-vote as a northern Isthmus/Delta representative — not a claimed proven path.

properties.name: Mount Sinai / Horeb (traditional Jebel Musa)
properties.location: Jebel Musa / St. Catherine traditional site (S Sinai) — location debated
properties.verses: Exodus 3:1; Exodus 19:1-25; Exodus 20:1-21; Numbers 33:15-16; Deuteronomy 1:2; 1 Kings 19:8; Galatians 4:25
properties.what_happened: Covenant mountain: theophany, Ten Words, tabernacle instructions. Israel camps about a year. Elijah later journeys here. Paul calls it “Sinai in Arabia.” Exact peak remains debated.
properties.sources: Exodus 19–40; Numbers 10; 33 (LSB). OpenBible.info Bible Geocoding Data (Mount Sinai) = traditional Jebel Musa. Hoffmeier favors southern Sinai; ABR/Bryant Wood favor Hashem el-Tarif; Midianite hypotheses use NW Arabia (Jabal al-Lawz / Hala-l Badr). AiG Searching for Sinai.
properties.notes: MAJOR DEBATE: Pin = Byzantine/traditional Jebel Musa (confidence traditional). Alternates: Gebel Khashm et-Tarif (~29.67,34.38), Har Karkom, Jabal al-Lawz (Saudi), Hala-l Badr. Deuteronomy 1:2 (11 days to Kadesh) and Midian proximity drive many proposals.
